definitions.uz: Biror narsani, ayniqsa yangi joyda qidirish yoki kashf qilish harakati.

examples: Budgets for space exploration have been cut back.
oil exploration (= searching for oil in the ground)
Lewis and Clark's exploration of the vast uncharted area of the north-west

definitions.en: To travel around a new or unknown place to learn about it.
definitions.ru: Путешествовать по новому или неизвестному месту, чтобы узнать о нем.
definitions.uz: Yangi yoki nomaʼlum joyni oʻrganish uchun sayohat qilmoq.

examples: As soon as we arrived on the island we were eager to explore.
explore something They explored the land to the south of the Murray River.
The city is best explored on foot.

definitions.en: A sudden and violent burst or shattering, often with a loud noise.
definitions.ru: Внезапный и сильный выброс энергии с громким звуком.
definitions.uz: To'satdan va kuchli otilish yoki parchalanib ketish, ko'pincha baland ovoz bilan.

examples: a bomb/nuclear/gas explosion
There were two loud explosions and then the building burst into flames.

definitions.en: A substance or device that can cause a sudden and violent release of energy, often resulting in an explosion.
definitions.ru: Вещество, способное к взрыву.
definitions.uz: Portlashga qodir modda.

examples: an explosive device (= a bomb)
an explosive mixture of chemicals
Hydrogen is highly explosive.

definitions.en: To send goods to another country for sale.
definitions.ru: Отправлять товары в другую страну для продажи.
definitions.uz: Tovarlarni sotish uchun boshqa davlatga jo'natmoq.

examples: a ban on the export of live cattle
for export Then the fruit is packaged for export.

definitions.en: To show something that is usually hidden; to reveal something secret or dishonest.
definitions.ru: Показывать что-то, что обычно скрыто; раскрывать что-то секретное или нечестное.
definitions.uz: Odatda yashirilgan narsani ko'rsatish; sir yoki halol bo'lmagan narsani ochib tashlash.

examples: expose something He smiled suddenly, exposing a set of amazingly white teeth.
Miles of sand are exposed at low tide.
My job as a journalist is to expose the truth.

definitions.en: The state of being in a place or situation where something harmful might affect you; the act of showing something.
definitions.ru: Состояние нахождения в месте или ситуации, где что-то вредное может повлиять на вас; действие показа чего-либо.
definitions.uz: Zararli narsa ta'sir qilishi mumkin bo'lgan joyda yoki vaziyatda bo'lish holati; biror narsani ko'rsatish harakati.

examples: prolonged exposure to harmful radiation
At high exposures, the chemical can affect the liver and kidneys.
(finance) the company’s exposure on the foreign exchange markets (= to the risk of making financial losses)

definitions.en: To show or make known a feeling, opinion, or idea by words, actions, or looks.
definitions.ru: Показывать или делать известным чувство, мнение или идею словами, действиями или взглядом.

examples: express something Teachers have expressed concern about the changes.
to express a view/an opinion
to express a hope/desire

definitions.en: A word or phrase that has a particular meaning.
definitions.ru: Слово или фраза со значением.

She uses a lot of slang expressions that I've never heard before.
Keep a list of useful words and expressions.

definitions.en: To make something longer or larger.

definitions.en: An addition to something, making it larger or longer.
definitions.ru: Увеличение размера или продолжительности.

a gradual extension of the powers of central government

definitions.en: Covering a large area; great in amount or degree.

definitions.en: In a detailed or widespread way.

definitions.en: The degree or size of something; how large, important, or serious something is.
definitions.ru: Размер, количество или важность чего-либо.

She was exaggerating the true extent of the problem.

definitions.en: Relating to the outside of something; coming from outside a place or organization.
definitions.ru: Наружный, относящийся к внешней стороне чего-либо.

definitions.en: Very great in degree; far from moderate.

definitions.en: Very, or to a very great degree.

extremely dangerous/serious/complex

definitions.en: The part of the body that you use to see.

furnishing fabrics

definitions.en: Extremely good or wonderful.
definitions.ru: Очень хороший, замечательный.

definitions.en: The front part of the head, from the forehead to the chin.

definitions.en: A place or building used for a particular activity or purpose.

medical/recreational/educational facilities

fact (that)… Isn't it a fact that the firm is losing money?

definitions.en: A group of people within a larger group who have different opinions and goals.
definitions.ru: Группа людей с разными взглядами внутри большей группы.

definitions.en: The teachers or professors in a university or college department; a department or group of departments within a university or college.

definitions.en: To gradually become less bright or strong.

definitions.en: To not succeed in what you are trying to do or are expected to do.

examples: The success or failure of the plan depends on you.
She is still coming to terms with the failure of her marriage.

definitions.ru: Относящийся ко всем одинаково, честный.

definitions.en: To a moderate degree; quite.
definitions.ru: в достаточной степени, умеренно

definitions.en: Not true or correct; incorrect.

examples: bus/taxi fares

examples: The sign said, ‘Private property. Keep out.’

a private jet

definitions.en: The act of changing something from being owned by the government to being owned by a private company.

definitions.en: A special advantage or right that is only available to a particular person or group.

definitions.en: Something that is given to someone who wins a competition or does something well.
definitions.ru: То, что дают победителю соревнования или за хорошие достижения.

definitions.en: The chance that something will happen.

definitions.en: Likely to happen or be true.

highly/quite/most probable

definitions.en: An investigation or examination to discover facts.

definitions.en: A set of actions that are the usual or correct way to do something.

definitions.ru: Официальное мероприятие или ряд действий в суде или в другом официальном контексте.

definitions.uz: Biror narsani ko'rsatish yoki ifodalash, yoki biror narsa haqida diqqat bilan o'ylash.

examples: be reflected (in something) His face was reflected in the mirror.
She looked into the water and saw her face reflected there.
She could see herself reflected in his eyes.

definitions.en: An image of something seen in a mirror or on a shiny surface.
definitions.ru: Изображение, видимое в зеркале или на блестящей поверхности.
definitions.uz: Oynada yoki yaltiroq sirtda ko'rinadigan tasvir.

examples: He admired his reflection in the mirror.

definitions.en: To improve something by making changes to it.
definitions.ru: Улучшение чего-либо путем внесения изменений.
definitions.uz: Nimadirni o'zgartirish orqali yaxshilash.

examples: a government committed to reform
economic/electoral/constitutional, etc. reform
the reform of the educational system

definitions.en: A place or situation that provides shelter or protection from danger or difficulty.
definitions.ru: Место, где можно укрыться от опасности или трудностей.
definitions.uz: Xavf yoki qiyinchiliklardan himoya qiladigan joy.

examples: A further 300 people have taken refuge in the US embassy.
The region was a place of refuge for outlaws and bandits.
refuge from somebody/something They were forced to seek refuge from the fighting.

definitions.en: A person who has been forced to leave their country in order to escape war, persecution, or natural disaster.
definitions.ru: Человек, покинувший свою страну из-за войны, преследований или катастрофы.
definitions.uz: Urush, taʼqib yoki tabiiy ofatdan qochish uchun oʻz mamlakatini tark etishga majbur boʻlgan shaxs.

examples: There has been a steady flow of refugees from the war zone.
political/economic refugees
political refugees

definitions.en: The act of saying no to something that you have been offered or asked to do.
definitions.ru: Действие, когда кто-то не соглашается на что-либо.
definitions.uz: Kimningdir nimagadir rozi bo'lmasligi.

examples: the refusal of a request/an invitation/an offer
a blunt/flat/curt refusal
refusal to do something His refusal to discuss the matter is very annoying.

definitions.en: To say that you will not do or accept something.
definitions.ru: Не соглашаться делать что-либо.
definitions.uz: Biror narsani qilishdan yoki qabul qilishdan bosh tortmoq.

examples: Go on, ask her; she can hardly refuse.
refuse to do something He flatly refused to discuss the matter.
She refused to accept that there was a problem.

definitions.en: To get something back that you lost or that was taken from you.
definitions.ru: Снова получить что-либо, что было потеряно или отобрано.
definitions.uz: Yo'qotilgan narsani qaytarib olish.

examples: I struggled to regain some dignity.
The party has regained control of the region.
She paused on the edge, trying to regain her balance.

definitions.en: Respect and consideration for someone or something.
definitions.ru: Чувство уважения и внимания к кому-либо или чему-либо.
definitions.uz: Kimdir yoki nimagadir hurmat va e'tibor hissi.

examples: regard for somebody/something to have scant/little/no regard for somebody/something
to pay/show little regard for other people’s property
Social services should pay proper regard to the needs of inner-city areas.

definitions.en: Despite something; without being affected by something.
definitions.ru: Не обращая внимания на что-либо; вопреки чему-либо.
definitions.uz: Nimaga qaramay; e'tibor bermasdan.

examples: The weather was terrible but we carried on regardless.

definitions.en: A government, especially one that has not been elected in a fair way.
definitions.ru: Политическая система или правительство, особенно несправедливое или авторитарное.
definitions.uz: Hukumat, ayniqsa adolatli saylanmagan.

examples: a fascist/totalitarian/military, etc. regime
an oppressive/brutal regime

definitions.en: An area of land, especially one that has particular features or is used for a particular purpose.
definitions.ru: Определенная территория с характерными особенностями.
definitions.uz: Ma'lum xususiyatlarga ega bo'lgan yer maydoni.

examples: mountainous/coastal regions
the northern/southern/central, etc. region
This is one of the most densely populated regions of North America.

definitions.en: Relating to a particular area or district of a country or the world.
definitions.ru: Относящийся к определенному региону или области.
definitions.uz: Muayyan hududga yoki mintaqaga tegishli.

examples: services available at a local and regional level
the conflict between regional and national interests
a regional assembly/council/government

definitions.en: An official list of names or events.
definitions.ru: Официальный список имен или событий.
definitions.uz: Ismlar yoki voqealarning rasmiy ro'yxati.

examples: The bride and groom signed the register.
Could you sign the hotel register please, sir?
register of somebody/something They keep a register of all those who have contributed to the fund.

definitions.en: the act of putting your name (or a thing’s details) on an official list
definitions.ru: внесение в официальный список
definitions.uz: rasmiylashtirish uchun ro‘yxatga yozish

examples: the registration of letters and parcels
the registration of students for a course
registration fees

definitions.en: A feeling of sadness or disappointment about something that has happened or something you have not done.
definitions.ru: Чувство грусти или разочарования из-за чего-то произошедшего или несделанного.
definitions.uz: O'tgan ish yoki qilinmagan ish uchun qayg'u hissi.

examples: a feeling/pang/twinge of regret
It is a matter of regret that no proper investigation was carried out at the time.
What is your greatest regret (= the thing that you are most sorry about doing or not doing)?

definitions.en: Happening or done often; following a pattern.
definitions.ru: Повторяющийся через равные промежутки времени; обычный, нормальный.
definitions.uz: Doimiy ravishda sodir bo'ladigan; odatiy.

examples: regular breathing
a regular pulse/heartbeat
A light flashed at regular intervals.

definitions.en: Often; at fixed times.
definitions.ru: В установленное время; часто.
definitions.uz: Belgilangan vaqtda.

examples: We meet regularly to discuss the progress of the project.
the introduction of direct, regularly scheduled flights to Beijing
The water in the fish tank should be changed regularly.

definitions.en: To control something by using rules.
definitions.ru: Управлять или контролировать что-либо с помощью правил.
definitions.uz: Qoidalar yordamida biror narsani nazorat qilish.

examples: The department is responsible for regulating the insurance industry.
The activities of credit companies are regulated by law.
The government accepts whaling in principle as long as it is carefully regulated.

definitions.en: An official rule or law that controls how something is done.
definitions.ru: Официальное правило или закон, определяющий порядок действий.
definitions.uz: Biror narsaning qanday bajarilishini nazorat qiluvchi rasmiy qoida yoki qonun.

examples: too many rules and regulations
fire/building regulations
the strict regulations governing the sale of weapons

definitions.en: A person or organization that controls an activity or industry and makes sure that it is done according to rules.
definitions.ru: Орган или лицо, контролирующее деятельность в определенной сфере.
definitions.uz: Faoliyat yoki sohani nazorat qiluvchi shaxs yoki tashkilot.

examples: Ofgas, the gas industry regulator
banking regulators

definitions.en: Relating to or controlling something, especially by rules.
definitions.ru: Относящийся к регулированию или контролю, обычно посредством правил.
definitions.uz: Qoidalarga asoslangan boshqaruvchi yoki nazorat qiluvchi.

examples: regulatory bodies/authorities/agencies
regulatory procedures

definitions.en: The process of helping someone return to a normal life after an illness, injury, or addiction.
definitions.ru: Восстановление здоровья или нормальной жизни после болезни, травмы или зависимости.
definitions.uz: Kasallik, jarohat yoki qaramlikdan keyin normal hayotga qaytishga yordam berish jarayoni.

examples: a drug rehabilitation centre
the rehabilitation of offenders

definitions.en: The period of time when a king, queen, emperor, etc., rules a country.
definitions.ru: Период правления монарха.
definitions.uz: Qirol, qirolicha yoki imperatorning hukmronlik davri.

examples: By the end of his reign, the vast empire was in decline.
in/during a reign The house was built during the reign of Henry VIII.

definitions.en: To make something stronger or more effective; to support an idea or feeling.
definitions.ru: Делать что-то сильнее или эффективнее; поддерживать идею или чувство.
definitions.uz: Nimadirni kuchliroq yoki samaraliroq qilish; g'oya yoki tuyg'uni qo'llab-quvvatlash.

examples: The experience reinforced my sense of loss.
Such jokes tend to reinforce gender stereotypes.
The climate of political confusion has only reinforced the country's economic decline.

definitions.en: To refuse to accept or agree with something.
definitions.ru: Не принимать, не соглашаться с чем-либо.
definitions.uz: Qabul qilmaslik, inkor etish.

examples: to reject an argument/a hypothesis/a notion/a plan
to reject a claim/an offer/a request/an application
The bank has the option of accepting or rejecting this offer.

definitions.en: The act of refusing to accept, agree with, or believe something or someone.
definitions.ru: Действие по значению глагола отказывать, отвергать.
definitions.uz: Qabul qilmaslik, rozi bo'lmaslik yoki ishonmaslik harakati.

examples: Her proposal met with unanimous rejection.

definitions.en: To connect or show a relationship between things.
definitions.ru: Устанавливать связь между чем-либо.
definitions.uz: Narsalar orasida bog'liqlik o'rnatish.

examples: relate something I found it difficult to relate the two ideas in my mind.
relate A to B In the future, pay increases will be related to productivity.
Attempts to relate studies on animals to those on humans are not really comparing like with like.

definitions.en: Connected to something or someone in some way.
definitions.ru: Имеющий отношение к чему-либо или кому-либо.
definitions.uz: Nimadir yoki kimdir bilan aloqasi bor.

examples: related to something/somebody The amount of protein you need is directly related to your lifestyle.
Much of the crime in this area is related to drug abuse.
Parental unemployment was not significantly related to youth unemployment for the total sample.

definitions.en: A connection between two or more people, groups, or countries; the way in which two or more people or things are connected.
definitions.ru: Связь между людьми, группами или странами.
definitions.uz: Odamlar, guruhlar yoki davlatlar o'rtasidagi aloqa.

examples: diplomatic/international/foreign relations
US-Chinese relations
teacher-student relations

definitions.en: The way in which two or more people or things are connected, or the state of being connected.
definitions.ru: Связь между двумя или более людьми или вещами.
definitions.uz: Ikki yoki undan ortiq odamlar yoki narsalar o'rtasidagi bog'liqlik.

examples: a personal/working relationship
a master-servant relationship
This is an opportunity to build positive customer relationships.

definitions.en: Connected to something else; considered in comparison to something else.
definitions.ru: Связанный с чем-либо другим; рассматриваемый в сравнении.
definitions.uz: Boshqa narsaga bog'liq; taqqoslashda ko'rib chiqiladi.

examples: You must consider the relative merits of the two plans.
We need to assess the relative importance of each of these factors.
We need to assess the relative strengths and weaknesses of each system.

definitions.en: Compared to something else; quite, but not extremely.
definitions.ru: В сравнении с чем-либо другим; в некоторой степени.
definitions.uz: Boshqa narsa bilan solishtirganda; ancha, lekin juda emas.

examples: relatively large/small/high/low
Lack of exercise is also a risk factor for heart disease but it's relatively small when compared with the others.
I found the test relatively easy.

definitions.en: To become or be more calm and less worried.
definitions.ru: Стать спокойным, перестать беспокоиться.
definitions.uz: Tinchlanmoq, xavotirlanmaslik.

examples: Just relax and enjoy the movie.
I'm going to spend the weekend just relaxing.
He was relaxing at home, watching TV.

definitions.en: Feeling calm and free from stress or worry.
definitions.ru: Чувствующий себя спокойно и свободно от стресса или беспокойства.
definitions.uz: Xotirjam va stress yoki tashvishdan xoli his qilish.

examples: He appeared relaxed and confident before the match.
She had a very relaxed manner.
She looked completely relaxed, as if she didn't have a worry in the world.

definitions.en: Making you feel calm and peaceful.
definitions.ru: Приносящий спокойствие и отдых.
definitions.uz: Tinchlik va osoyishtalik keltiruvchi.

examples: a relaxing evening with friends
a relaxing weekend/afternoon/holiday
a relaxing bath/massage

definitions.en: To allow someone or something to be free; to make something available to the public.
definitions.ru: Дать свободу кому-либо или чему-либо; сделать что-либо доступным для публики.
definitions.uz: Kimnidir yoki nimanidir erkin qo'yish; nimadirni ommaga taqdim etish.

examples: release of somebody/something The government has been working to secure the release of the hostages.
The judges ordered the release of prisoners who were political opponents of the government.
The public demanded her release.

definitions.en: The quality of being closely connected or appropriate to the matter at hand.
definitions.ru: Свойство быть относящимся к делу, важным.
definitions.uz: Mavzuga aloqadorlik yoki muhimlik xususiyati.

examples: I don't see the relevance of your question.
relevance to something What he said has no direct relevance to the matter in hand.

definitions.en: Closely connected to the matter at hand; important and appropriate.
definitions.ru: Имеющий прямое отношение к обсуждаемому вопросу; важный и подходящий.
definitions.uz: Muhokama qilinayotgan masalaga bevosita aloqador; muhim va mos.

examples: relevant information/facts/documents/factors
The incident is still under investigation by the relevant authorities.
a relevant suggestion/question/point

definitions.en: The quality of being trustworthy or of performing consistently well.
definitions.ru: Качество, когда что-то можно считать верным или на что-то можно положиться.
definitions.uz: Biror narsaga ishonish yoki doim yaxshi ishlash sifati.

examples: The incident cast doubt on her motives and reliability.

definitions.en: Someone or something that is reliable can be trusted or depended on.
definitions.ru: Тот, на кого или на что можно положиться.
definitions.uz: Ishonish mumkin bo'lgan shaxs yoki narsa.

examples: We are looking for someone who is reliable and hard-working.
a reliable friend
He was a very reliable and honest man who would never betray anyone.

definitions.en: A feeling of comfort when something unpleasant stops or does not happen.
definitions.ru: Чувство облегчения, когда что-то неприятное прекращается.
definitions.uz: Noqulay narsa to'xtaganda yoki bo'lmaganda yuzaga keladigan his.

examples: I felt a huge sense of relief when I heard they were all OK.
We all breathed a sigh of relief when he left.
Much to my relief the car was not damaged.

definitions.en: To reduce pain, anxiety, or other unpleasant feelings.
definitions.ru: Уменьшать боль, тревогу или другие неприятные ощущения.
definitions.uz: Ogʻriq, xavotir yoki boshqa yoqimsiz hislarni kamaytirish.

examples: to relieve the symptoms of a cold
to relieve anxiety/guilt/stress
Being able to tell the truth at last seemed to relieve her.

definitions.en: Feeling happy because something unpleasant has stopped or not happened.
definitions.ru: Испытывающий чувство облегчения, избавления от неприятностей.
definitions.uz: Noqulaylik tugaganidan xursand bo'lgan.

examples: She sounded relieved.
relieved to see, hear, find, etc. something You'll be relieved to know your jobs are safe.
relieved (that)… I'm just relieved that nobody was hurt.

definitions.en: A system of faith and worship, often involving a belief in a god or gods.
definitions.ru: Система верований и обрядов, связанных с верой в бога или богов.
definitions.uz: Xudo yoki xudolarga ishonish bilan bog'liq bo'lgan e'tiqod va ibodat tizimi.

examples: Is there always a conflict between science and religion?
by religion They are Jewish by religion.

definitions.en: Connected with a religion; believing in a religion.
definitions.ru: Связанный с религией; верующий.
definitions.uz: Dinga aloqador; dinga ishonadigan.

examples: religious beliefs/convictions/faith
religious freedom/liberty
religious traditions/practices/ceremonies

definitions.en: Unwilling and hesitant; not wanting to do something.
definitions.ru: Не желающий что-либо делать.
definitions.uz: Biror narsani qilishni xohlamaydigan.

examples: He finally gave a reluctant smile.
They nodded in reluctant agreement.
reluctant to do something She was reluctant to admit she was wrong.

definitions.en: To depend on someone or something; to trust or have faith in.
definitions.ru: Основывать свои действия или ожидания на ком-то или чем-то.
definitions.uz: Kimga yoki nimaga ishonish yoki bog'liq bo'lish.

definitions.en: To stay in the same place or condition.
definitions.ru: Продолжать находиться в том же месте или состоянии.
definitions.uz: Bir xil joyda yoki holatda qolish.

examples: remain + adj. to remain silent
to remain standing/seated/motionless
to remain calm/confident

definitions.en: The part of something that is left after the rest has been removed or used.
definitions.ru: То, что осталось после использования или удаления части.
definitions.uz: Biror narsaning qolgan qismi.

examples: I kept some of his books and gave away the remainder.

definitions.en: The parts of something that are left after the rest has been used, destroyed, or has disappeared.
definitions.ru: То, что осталось после использования, разрушения или исчезновения чего-либо.
definitions.uz: Biror narsaning qolgan qismlari ishlatilgandan, yo'q qilingandan yoki yo'qolgandan keyin.

examples: She fed the remains of her lunch to the dog.

definitions.en: A comment or statement.
definitions.ru: Краткое высказывание или комментарий.
definitions.uz: Qisqa izoh yoki fikr.

examples: to make a remark
remark by somebody The controversy intensified following remarks by the President of the European Commission.
What exactly did you mean by that last remark?

definitions.en: Unusual or surprising in a way that causes admiration or attention.
definitions.ru: Необычный или удивительный, вызывающий восхищение или внимание.
definitions.uz: G'ayrioddiy yoki hayratlanarli darajada ajoyib, qoyil qoldiradigan yoki e'tiborni tortadigan.

examples: a remarkable achievement/career/talent
She was a truly remarkable woman.
What is even more remarkable about the whole thing is…

definitions.en: In a way that is surprising or unusual.
definitions.ru: Необычно, вызывающе удивление.
definitions.uz: Kutilmagan, hayratlanarli tarzda.

examples: The car is in remarkably good condition for its age.
Remarkably, nobody was killed.
The two reports are remarkably similar.

definitions.en: A way of curing an illness or solving a problem.
definitions.ru: Способ лечения болезни или решения проблемы.
definitions.uz: Kasallikni davolash yoki muammoni hal qilish usuli.

examples: When the reservoir becomes blocked, the only remedy lies in cleaning the entire system.
remedy for something There is no simple remedy for unemployment.
remedy to something There are a number of possible remedies to this problem.

definitions.en: To recall something from the past.
definitions.ru: Вспоминать, держать в памяти.
definitions.uz: Xotirlash, esga tushirish.

examples: remember somebody/something This is Carla. Do you remember her?
I don't remember my first day at school.
I'll always remember this holiday.

definitions.en: To make someone remember something or someone.
definitions.ru: Вызывать в памяти воспоминания о ком-либо или чём-либо.
definitions.uz: Nimadir yoki kimnidir esga solmoq.

examples: remind somebody/yourself I'm sorry, I've forgotten your name. Can you remind me?
That (= what you have just said, done, etc.) reminds me, I must get some cash.
‘You need to finish that essay.’ ‘Don't remind me (= I don't want to think about it).’

definitions.en: Something that helps you remember something.
definitions.ru: То, что помогает вспомнить.
definitions.uz: Nimadirni eslatuvchi narsa.

examples: reminder of something The sheer size of the cathedral is a constant reminder of the power of religion.
The incident served as a timely reminder of just how dangerous mountaineering can be.
reminder that… The article concludes with a chilling reminder that the disease can strike anyone at any time.

definitions.en: Far away from cities and places where many people live; distant.
definitions.ru: Находящийся далеко от городов и населённых мест; далёкий.
definitions.uz: Shaharlar va odamlar ko'p yashaydigan joylardan uzoqda; masofaviy.

examples: a remote village/island/location/region
a remote community
a remote part of the country

definitions.en: The act of taking something away or getting rid of something.
definitions.ru: Действие по устранению или извлечению чего-либо.
definitions.uz: Biror narsani olib tashlash harakati.

examples: Clearance of the site required the removal of a number of trees.
the removal of a tumour
Allegations of abuse led to the removal of several children from their families.

definitions.en: To take something away or off from a place or position.
definitions.ru: Убрать что-либо откуда-либо.
definitions.uz: Biror narsani joyidan olib tashlash.

examples: remove somebody/something Illegally parked vehicles will be removed.
remove somebody/something from somebody/something He removed his hand from her shoulder.
Three children were removed from the school for persistent bad behaviour.

definitions.en: To cause someone or something to be in a particular state.
definitions.ru: Приводить в определенное состояние.
definitions.uz: Kimnidir yoki nimadirni ma'lum bir holatga keltirish.

examples: to render something harmless/useless/ineffective
Hundreds of people were rendered homeless by the earthquake.

definitions.en: To begin or resume (an activity) again; to replace something that has expired or been used up.
definitions.ru: Начать снова; заменить истекшее или использованное.
definitions.uz: Eskirgan yoki tugagan narsani yangilash yoki qayta boshlash.

examples: The army renewed its assault on the capital.
We have to renew our efforts to attract young players.
The annual dinner is a chance to renew acquaintance with old friends.

definitions.en: Widely known and respected; famous.
definitions.ru: Широко известный и уважаемый.
definitions.uz: Keng tanilgan va hurmatga sazovor.

examples: a renowned author
We asked for advice from the renowned legal expert, Sam Pincher.
renowned as something It is renowned as one of the region's best restaurants.

definitions.en: Money you pay regularly to use a house, room, office, etc.
definitions.ru: Деньги, которые регулярно платят за использование дома, комнаты, офиса и т. д.
definitions.uz: Uy, xona, ofis va hokazolardan foydalanish uchun muntazam to'lanadigan pul.

examples: I earn just about enough to pay the rent.
How much rent do you pay for this place?
The landlord has put the rent up again.

definitions.en: The act of paying to use something, like a house or car, for a set time.
definitions.ru: Оплата за использование имущества на определенный срок.
definitions.uz: Ma'lum bir muddatga mulkdan foydalanish uchun to'lov.

examples: Telephone charges include line rental.

definitions.en: To fix something that is broken or damaged.
definitions.ru: Исправить что-то сломанное или поврежденное.
definitions.uz: Buzilgan yoki shikastlangan narsani tuzatish.

examples: They agreed to pay the costs of any repairs.
The building was in need of repair.
for repair I took my bike in for repair.

definitions.en: To say or do something again.
definitions.ru: Сказать или сделать что-то снова.
definitions.uz: Biror narsani qayta aytish yoki qilish.

examples: repeat of something She didn't want a repeat performance of what had happened the night before.
A repeat of the 1906 earthquake could kill up to 11 000 people.
(business) a repeat order (= for a further supply of the same goods)

definitions.en: Happening or done many times in a similar way.
definitions.ru: Происходящий или сделанный много раз похожим образом.
definitions.uz: Bir xil tarzda ko'p marta sodir bo'ladigan yoki qilinadigan.

examples: repeated absences from work
She did not respond to repeated requests for interviews.
The marriage failed despite repeated attempts to save it.

definitions.en: To take the place of something or someone.
definitions.ru: Занять место другого объекта или человека.
definitions.uz: Biror narsaning yoki shaxsning o'rnini egallash.

examples: The new design will eventually replace all existing models.

a poem supposedly written by Shakespeare

definitions.en: To stop something from being expressed or published; to end something by force.
definitions.ru: Остановить, прекратить что-либо, обычно силой.
definitions.uz: Biror narsani to'xtatish yoki kuch bilan bostirish.

definitions.en: Highest in rank, power, or authority.
definitions.ru: Наивысший по рангу, власти или авторитету.

sure (that)… I'm pretty sure (that) he'll agree.

definitions.en: Used to express that you are almost certain about something.

definitions.en: The outside layer of something; the top part of something.
definitions.ru: Внешний слой или верхняя часть чего-либо.

an uneven road surface
a broad leaf with a large surface area

a surge of excitement

definitions.uz: Shifokorning shikastlangan yoki kasal qismlarini tuzatish yoki olib tashlash uchun odamning tanasini kesib tashlashi bilan bog'liq tibbiy muolaja.

to undergo heart/knee/shoulder surgery

definitions.en: Something unexpected that causes a feeling of wonder or excitement.
definitions.ru: Неожиданное событие или вещь, вызывающая удивление.

I have a surprise for you!
a surprise attack

definitions.en: Feeling or showing surprise; feeling amazed or shocked by something unexpected.

The frequency of such bad weather is hardly surprising given how far north we are.

definitions.en: To stop fighting and admit defeat; to give yourself to the control of someone else.
definitions.ru: Прекратить сопротивление и признать поражение; отдать себя под контроль другого.

be surrounded by something The garden is surrounded by a wall.

the immediately surrounding area

definitions.ru: Продолжать жить или существовать, особенно после опасного события.

be suspended by/on something from something A boat was suspended on wires from the rafters.

definitions.en: The act of stopping someone from doing something, especially going to school or work, for a specific period.
definitions.ru: Временное отстранение от работы, учебы или участия в чем-либо.

definitions.en: A feeling that someone might be guilty of something or that something is not right.

definitions.en: Feeling or showing a belief that someone has done something wrong or dishonest.

definitions.en: To keep something in existence or continue for a period of time.

definitions.en: Able to be maintained at a certain rate or level; avoiding depletion of natural resources.
definitions.ru: Способный поддерживаться на определенном уровне без истощения ресурсов.

swallow something + adj. The pills should be swallowed whole.

definitions.en: To clean a floor or other surface using a brush.

definitions.en: To say words; to have a conversation.
